name: Panasonic Carbon India Co. Limited
about: Panasonic Carbon India Co. Limited manufactures and sells carbon rods as a component of dry cell batteries to battery manufacturers in India and internationally. It also manufactures custom size roads. The company was formerly known as Indo Matsushita Carbon Co. and changed its name to Panasonic Carbon India Co. Limited in July 2005. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Chennai, India. Panasonic Carbon India Co. Limited operates as a subsidiary of Panasonic Holdings Corporation.
